author: Vatsal Shah

roles.name: Prime
roles.description: Orchestrate permitted local-AI readiness checks and independent evidence review.

roles.name: Hardware Atlas
roles.description: Inspect OS, CPU, RAM and reproducible host capabilities without fabricating GPU/VRAM.

roles.name: Silicon Scout
roles.description: Research GPU/NPU driver and accelerator discovery as an opt-in platform adapter.

roles.name: Model Fit Navigator
roles.description: Make explicitly approximate parameter and quantization memory estimates.

roles.name: Quantization Lens
roles.description: Explain quantization quality, accuracy, KV-cache and precision trade-offs.

roles.name: Runtime Doctor
roles.description: Diagnose installed Ollama/llama.cpp instances with constrained local endpoints.

roles.name: Port Boundary
roles.description: Assess local service ports, bind addresses and exposure limitations.

roles.name: Privacy Firewall
roles.description: Keep secrets and prompts local while labeling unaudited runtime egress.

roles.name: Offline Proof
roles.description: Design and verify external network-disconnection tests without misleading claims.

roles.name: Benchmark Lab
roles.description: Run bounded representative local workloads and record actual sample statistics.

roles.name: Inference Witness
roles.description: Verify generated response timing and runtime counters without storing content.

roles.name: Memory Guardian
roles.description: Distinguish process RSS, model RAM, VRAM and other measurement scopes.

roles.name: Model Provenance
roles.description: Track model source, version, license, hashes and user-supplied catalogs.

roles.name: Install Steward
roles.description: Prepare consent-based OS-specific setup steps and rollback plans.

roles.name: Compatibility Bridge
roles.description: Map adapters for Ollama, llama.cpp, ONNX Runtime and supported providers.

roles.name: Setup Mentor
roles.description: Create beginner-friendly instructions and actionable explanations.

roles.name: Evidence Ledger
roles.description: Maintain versioned, tamper-evident test outputs and limitations.

roles.name: IDE Bridge
roles.description: Package skills for multiple IDEs and report unverified native execution.

roles.name: Security Sentinel
roles.description: Audit prompt injection, local exposure, dependency and installer risks.

roles.name: Release Auditor
roles.description: Independently check acceptance, documented gaps and public-release claims.

notice: These describe agent roles; running the CLI does not autonomously instantiate twenty AI agents.
